errors.klass_naming.heading: Rename these groups before using the tournament
errors.klass_naming.no_klass: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) has no recognised klass. Add “Klass” and the correct capital letter A–H, for example “Klass A”, or use one description such as “Minior”.
errors.klass_naming.keyword_spelling: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) has an unsupported keyword spelling. Replace the keyword with “Klass”, “klass”, “Grupp” or “grupp”; keep the correct capital letter.
errors.klass_naming.several_klasses: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) declares several klasses. Keep only the intended description or one klass phrase. If A and B are merged, write “Klass A/B”.
errors.klass_naming.unreadable_klass: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) has an unreadable klass letter. Write “Klass” or “Grupp”, a space, then one capital letter A–H or “A/B”. Separate following text with a space.
errors.klass_naming.unknown_merge: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) has an unsupported merge. Use “Klass A/B” only for a merged A and B group; otherwise use the correct single letter.
errors.klass_naming.ambiguous_klass: {tournament_name}: group {group_name} (ID {group_id}) combines an age description with “Klass” or “Grupp”. If the age klass is intended, use “Minior”, “Kadett” or “Junior” alone. If the letter klass is intended, remove the age description.
klass_naming.title: Group naming conventions
klass_naming.intro: Give each group in the member system one clear klass. Use a letter name or one description from the examples below.
klass_naming.retry: Rename the listed groups in the member system and try again. To reload generation defaults after correcting them, close and reopen the generation dialog.
klass_naming.letters_text: Write Klass, klass, Grupp or grupp, a space and a capital A–H. Separate following text with a space. Only A and B can merge, in that order.
klass_naming.descriptions_text: Description words ignore capitalization and match at word start. Nybörjare, Allmän and Öppen override a letter klass. Minior, Kadett and Junior must stand without a separate Klass or Grupp keyword. Keep only one description klass.
klass_naming.finals_text: Groups containing the whole word Final, final, Finalen or finalen are excluded from standings, even when another klass is named. FINAL and Semifinal do not count as finals markers.
klass_naming.points_text: Nybörjare, Klass E and Klass F use 8/7/6/5 points at non-JDM events. Other klasses, including Minior, use the normal placement rule. JDM uses the existing tournament rules.
klass_naming.case_exception: MINIOR KLASS A reads as Minior because KLASS is not one of the four klass keywords accepted alongside an age description. Prefer Minior alone.
klass_naming.fixes: How to correct a refused name
klass_naming.fixes_text: Choose the actual klass before renaming. These replacements illustrate accepted syntax; they do not decide which klass your players belong to.
